name: Client final cleanup red-team End-to-End closure
objective: Prove the integrated client slice has no known dead action, duplicate/legacy path, unresolved client defect or adversarial failure and is verified on the exact final candidate before closure.
truthOwner: Cross-owner verification; no new business truth owner.

tasks.objective: Census every client-visible action and remove proven dead, duplicate, legacy or unreachable residue.
tasks.currentProblem: The re-audit found a visible profile action with no route and a legacy WltClientWalletPanel alias/barrel candidate. Static green checks do not prove every button, deep link, tab, adapter and export is reachable and canonical.
tasks.requiredChange: Build a source/runtime census from DshClientSurface, every app-client screen and runtime shell to each visible action/deep link/API. For each item prove governed reachability or remove the misleading/dead affordance. Reference-census compatibility wrappers, aliases, obsolete fixtures/fallbacks, duplicate adapters, unused exports/config/dependencies and generated artifacts before deletion.
tasks.targetState: Every visible client action reaches one supported governed path; no proven dead alias, duplicate truth, inert business action or obsolete compatibility layer remains in client scope.
tasks.action: Run reachability/reference/contract census and delete only proven residue, reopening the owning unit if the dead path exposes a missing feature rather than cleanup.
mustNotChange: No deletion based only on grep if barrel/dynamic usage is plausible.
No guard weakening or hidden inert UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Every visible client action/deep link has a governed reachable target or is removed by explicit product disposition.
No proven dead client compatibility alias or duplicate adapter remains.
No unsupported fixture/fallback can become runtime business truth.
Generated sources and contracts remain canonical.
tasks.rollback: Restore only an element proven required by a supported client and then route it through canonical ownership.

tasks.objective: Run adversarial cross-unit red-team and repair every client-scope finding.
tasks.currentProblem: Unit-local tests cannot prove replay, race, restart, offline, cross-actor, cross-surface, provider-unknown and stale deep-link interactions across all seven implementation units.
tasks.requiredChange: Attack wrong actor/role/surface, stale version, replay, concurrent taps, timeout, provider unknown result, offline/kill/relaunch, cache/push staleness, deep-link authorization, location/proof privacy, subscription/payment/cancel races and cross-surface transition ordering.
tasks.targetState: No known adversarial case creates unauthorized access, duplicate effect, false final state, privacy leak, lost durable attempt or split truth.
tasks.action: Execute the matrix and reopen/fix the owning U001-U007 until the exact candidate is clean.
mustNotChange: No unrelated external blocker converted into client code.
acceptanceCriteria: All required adversarial client cases pass.
Every client-scope finding is fixed at canonical owner.
Regression and cross-surface readback remain consistent.
tasks.rollback: Never restore a red-team defect; reopen the owner unit.
tasks.commitBoundary: Root-cause commits remain attributed to owner units.

tasks.objective: Reclassify current external blockers and prove exact-candidate closure without scope leakage.
tasks.currentProblem: Current project-wide failures include DSH partner-evidence readiness, WLT payout compile/readiness, Field payout/onboarding contract bindings, Partner payout runtime smoke and unrelated control-panel diagnostics. Some block full CI but are not client implementation authority.
tasks.requiredChange: After the last client write, re-pin exact HEAD and re-run strict package validation plus applicable contracts, client tests, targeted/full Identity/DSH/WLT, DB, runtime, native/device, security and CI. Reclassify each remaining failure by trace: repair it here only if it is client-owned or a canonical dependency whose defect materially breaks a client journey; otherwise keep it as an external closure blocker for its owning package.
tasks.targetState: The client package contains zero known in-scope defect and closure is declared only when required exact-SHA gates are actually green; unrelated work never enters merely to make this package look complete.
tasks.action: Repin after last write, execute gates, inspect artifacts, reconcile concurrent branch movement and update RESULT/CLOSURE only from same-SHA evidence.
mustNotChange: No Partner/Field payout/onboarding implementation unless a direct client trace is proven.
acceptanceCriteria: Strict validator reports zero errors on exact package.
Every client-owned required check is PASS on exact final SHA.
Any remaining project failure has explicit non-client evidence and still blocks only the appropriate global closure, not by being hidden.
CLOSURE/RESULT move to CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE only after all required package checks pass.
tasks.rollback: A failed final gate reopens its owner unit; evidence is never rewritten to hide failure.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final bookkeeping only after all implementation writes and exact-SHA readback.
